fields.Name: IT132 - Alternate Base Views
fields.Description: Proves Alternate Base Views (MJ Canon Layer 1) metadata, physical constraints, RunView routing, fail-closed validation, LocalCacheManager abv:<Name> cache key isolation, and ParentID hierarchy against a live database. Deterministic, read-only, LLM-free. 6 checks ABV1-ABV6.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All 6 checks pass: metadata and validators coherent, physical constraints present on EntityAlternateBaseView, RunView routes simple/count_only/Aggregates through registered AlternateBaseView, unknown or Disabled AlternateBaseView fails closed, LocalCacheManager isolates abv:<Name> fingerprints, and EntityAlternateBaseViewInfo hierarchy + EntityInfo lookups resolve accurately.
